title: Preserve scanner failure truth when Semgrep returns JSON
problem: Semgrep exit 2 with structured errors, and exit 0 with an absent results array, are reported as successful scans. Existing orchestration marks incomplete only on scanner failed status.
hypothesis: Validate Semgrep completion metadata independently of parsed findings so structured failures cannot appear as clean security passes.
alternative_solutions: Disable Semgrep integration until a trusted execution design exists
Keep current behavior with a warning only; rejected because completion remains incorrect
why_build: Direct synthetic reproduction and source establish a narrow false-clean bug; docs/design-spec.md requires understandable infrastructure failure and honest assessment. Standing scheduled authorization approves bounded low/medium-risk BUILD fixes.
why_not_build: Does not establish trusted binaries/config provenance, sandboxing or complete scan coverage; malformed individual findings need conservative handling. No measured user demand or exploit incidence.
acceptance_criteria: Only a normal successful exit and a valid results array without structured errors may report success
Nonzero exit, signal termination, structured errors or malformed envelope report failed
Valid parsed findings survive a failed/partial scan
A failed scan propagates incomplete conclusion and summary
No action input/output defaults, scanner arguments, executable selection, CI or dependency changes
human_decision: Pre-approved for bounded implementation by this scheduled task; merge/release separately gated on rollout and rollback readiness.
what_would_change_conclusion: A documented Semgrep completion contract showing the synthetic error payload is a successful complete scan.
